research_questions.RQ1: Does uncertainty-preserving event reconstruction reduce wrong links and control manual review volume vs simple identifier joins and appropriate existing methods?
research_questions.RQ2: Does adding record-quality and processing-stage signals improve within-horizon first-event prediction vs aging and basic baselines?

conclusion_conditions.positive: Candidate improves a pre-specified metric on the locked test set beyond a pre-specified margin, with uncertainty intervals excluding null.
conclusion_conditions.negative: No improvement, or worse. Reported as-is; not repaired by changing ground truth.
conclusion_conditions.inconclusive: Insufficient sample or class counts; INSUFFICIENT_DATA recorded, no probabilities fabricated.

change_history.summary: interval_days 1->5 after sparsity findings; see research/protocol_changes.csv
